在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。

texts.zh:
在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。
texts.en:
Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information about our culture in their memory cores as a form of greeting to alien civilizations.

It has now been realized that this data could potentially be used against us. We need to track down these probes before they are found by someone - or something - unsympathetic to our species!

tooltips.zh: 开始亚光速探测器事件链
tooltips.en: Begins the Sublight Exploration Probes Event Chain

texts.zh: 早在掌握超光速旅行之前，我们从[Root.Capital.GetName]向邻近的恒星系发射了数个亚光速探测器。我们必须在它们落入敌人的手中之前先将他们回收。
texts.en: Several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] to neighboring systems before we had mastered FTL travel. They must be recovered before they fall into hostile hands.

texts.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者出走，并组建了自己的教派。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，是多年以来多起破坏事件的罪魁祸首。

虽然在现代，他们保持低调克制，但我们最近获悉，他们的许多特工渗透进了我方。这些叛徒将我们的资源秘密转移到了隐藏在[Root.Capital.GetName]的小型星际舰队建造项目中！当他们的背叛行为被揭发时，这些异教徒乘船冲进了轨道，然后逃向了[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。
texts.en:
Centuries ago, a group of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] broke away from the established religions to form their own church. These extremists called themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], and have been responsible for many atrocities and acts of terror over the years.

Although they have kept a low profile in modern times, we recently learned that many of their agents have infiltrated our military. These renegades have secretly been diverting resources to the construction of a small fleet of starships at a hidden facility on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their treachery was revealed, the cultists blasted into orbit on their ships and fled to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者从主教派中分裂，歪曲传统捏造了它们自己扭曲的教条。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，长久以来以狂热著称，他们的仪式充满了血腥和神秘。

虽然他们在黑暗中躲藏了许多年……但现在，他们的背叛暴露无遗。我们发现许多他们带队特工已经渗入了军队，在[Root.Capital.GetName]的一个隐蔽的产卵舱里盗取资源，组建了一支非法舰队！当他们的背叛被揭露后，这些邪教分子释放了他们令人憎恶的东西——在他们堕落扭曲的信仰中秘密孕育的活体星舰。这些异端的战体从地下的摇篮中蜂拥而出，呼啸着逃向[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。

不管变成什么样子，他们都已不再是我们的族类。他们的舰船不会我们的那样歌唱，只是尖叫。
texts.en:
Centuries ago, a sect of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] splintered from the dominant faiths, forsaking tradition to form their own twisted doctrine. Calling themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], they have long been known for their zealotry, their rituals steeped in blood and secrecy.

For years, they have remained hidden in the shadows... but now, their treachery is laid bare. We have discovered that many of their agents had infiltrated our military, siphoning resources to grow an illicit fleet within a hidden spawning chamber on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their betrayal was exposed, the cultists unleashed their abominations - living starships, gestated in secrecy and warped by their corrupted faith. These heretical warforms burst from their underground cradles, howling into the sky before escaping to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

Whatever they have become, they are no longer our kin. Their ships do not sing as ours do. They screech.

label.zh: 我们可以学着原谅他们。
label.en: We can learn to forgive them.

texts.zh: 自称“[radical_cult.GetName]”的极端组织正试图暗中颠覆我们，蛊惑民众信仰他们扭曲的教义。他们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上历兵秣马了数世纪，他们的领袖现已逃往了外太空，以继续进行反对我们的运动。
texts.en: Members of an extremist cult calling themselves the "[radical_cult.GetName]" are seeking to undermine our government and subvert the populace to their twisted religion. After spending centuries quietly building up their strength on [Root.Capital.GetName], their leaders have now fled into space to continue their crusade against us.

texts.zh: 一位弃暗投明的[radical_cult.GetName]前成员说服了他的老同志放弃狂热，加入我们的行列。他们的旗舰现在在[Root.capital_scope.GetName]轨道上运行，等待正式编入我们海军之前的检查。
texts.en: A former member of the [radical_cult.GetName], now fully committed to our cause, has convinced their old comrades to abandon their fanaticism and join our ranks. Their flagship now orbits [Root.capital_scope.GetName], awaiting inspection before its formal induction into our navy.

tooltips.zh: 成为创造的黎明的拥有者。
tooltips.en: Becomes the owner of the Dawn of Creation.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
texts.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

texts.zh:
首席科学官——准确来说应该是前首席科学官——还没有找到。但是一些关于科研船试验机以及长官的私人研究的消息却已经传到了我们的耳朵里。虽然有一些太过离谱，但显而易见的是尽快寻回首席关乎着[Root.GetName]的利益。

情报日志已更新。
texts.en:
The whereabouts of the Head - now technically the former Head of Research - have yet to be ascertained. Certain details regarding the prototype Science Ship and the Head's private research have reached our ears, and while some aspects seem too fantastical to be true, it is clear that it is in the [Root.GetName]'s interest to find and recover the Chair as soon as possible.

The Situation Log has been updated.

tooltips.zh: 开启“浪迹星涯：叛变科学官”事件链
tooltips.en: Begins the Wanderlust: Rogue Scientist Event Chain

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]理论科学委员会的主席和一架非常规科研船原型机一起消失了。

我们已经将他们的下落锁定到三个可能的地点，可以依次排查。
texts.en:
The Chair of the [Root.GetName]'s Abstract Sciences Board has gone missing along with an unorthodox Science Ship prototype.

Their current whereabouts have been narrowed down to three likely locations, to be investigated in turn.

texts.zh:
我们向[Root.Capital.GetName]之上的虚空迈出的第一步并不单单只是受到好奇心或征服欲的驱使，更是一种必要之举。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的生物圈经历了剧烈的变化。科学家们警告大灭绝将很有可能发生，这种周期性的生物灭亡是这个宇宙中行星生物的自然规律。

我们制定了一个研究项目，对象是几颗因重大天文灾害而变得不宜居行星。通过还原这些灾难性事件，我们预期可以避免[Root.Capital.GetName]和[Root.GetSpeciesName]一族重蹈覆辙。
texts.en:
Our first steps into the void beyond [Root.Capital.GetName] were driven not just by curiosity or conquest but by necessity.

The biosphere of [Root.Capital.GetName] has rapidly changed, with scientists warning of a potential mass extinction event, a cyclical purging of life inherent to planetary existence in the cosmos.

A research plan has been developed to study planets rendered uninhabitable by major astronomical incidents. By reconstructing these events, we hope to avoid a similar fate for [Root.Capital.GetName] and the [Root.GetSpeciesName] race.

texts.zh: 为了避免[Root.Capital.GetName]上可能发生的大灾难造成严重后果，我们必须研究其他星球上的灾难都造成了什么后果。
texts.en: To avoid a potential apocalypse on [Root.Capital.GetName], we must study the effects that major calamities have had on other planets.

texts.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了宗教仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管少数几个知情者对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无异。
texts.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentices" gather in the Chamber of Elevation for a special ceremony. What exactly happens to them is a closely-guarded secret known only to a select few, but when they emerge, they do so as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

texts.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管集体意识对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]子个体无异。
texts.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentices" gather in the Chamber of Elevation for a special ceremony. What exactly happens to them is a secret closely-guarded by our collective consciousness, but when they emerge, they do so as [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] drones.

tooltips.zh:
到今年年底，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的[necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural]将会全部被转化成[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

这个仪式将每隔10年在各个建有升格之室[Root.GetAdj]星球上举行一次。
tooltips.en:
At the end of the year, all [necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural] on [Root.Capital.GetName] will be converted into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

This ceremony will take place every 10 years on each [Root.GetAdj] planet with a Chamber of Elevation.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
texts.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.

sections.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
sections.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.

texts.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
texts.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

sections.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
sections.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

texts.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是弥那玛特种实业集团的母星。
texts.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as Minamar Specialized Industries.

sections.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是弥那玛特种实业集团的母星。
sections.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as Minamar Specialized Industries.

texts.zh: 我们遭遇到了被称为抟土之塑师的虚境实体之后，集体网络中涌现的反常行为发生了显著增加。受到影响的自动机——“虚铸者”们——开始要求特殊权利和对待。我们如何应对将决定[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的进程。
texts.en: After we encountered the Shroud entity known as the Animator of Clay, a significant increase in deviant behavior has emerged throughout the collective network. The afflicted automata - the 'Shroud-Forged' - now demand special rights and treatment. Our response will define the course of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

texts.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
texts.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

sections.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
sections.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

texts.zh: 太空兽群会将我们的种荚带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
texts.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our Seed Pods to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.

texts.zh: 随着在[root.capital_scope.GetName]上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
texts.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the [root.capital_scope.GetName], our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been identified throughout the vessel.

texts.zh: 护盾诊断显示有几个发射器未对准，需要重新校准。
texts.en: Shield diagnostics indicate several projectors are misaligned and require recalibration.

texts.zh: 一个来自未经探索的恒星系的信号，已开始在我们的通信数据库中自我复制。
texts.en: A signal originating from an unexplored star system has begun replicating itself across our communications databanks.

texts.zh: 多个传感器阵列检测到持续的干涉模式。
texts.en: Persistent interference patterns have been detected across multiple sensor arrays.

texts.zh: 腐蚀性冷却液泄漏正在危及船体完整性。
texts.en: Corrosive coolant leaks are compromising hull integrity.

texts.zh: 多个机库早已被改作仓库之用，限制了我方机组人员的作战备勤能力。
texts.en: Multiple hangar bays have long since been repurposed as storage, limiting the operational readiness of our flight crews.

texts.zh: 方舟舰的开采系统尚未在实际运行条件下进行过测试。资源勘探表明，周边星系中存在具有开采价值的矿藏。
texts.en: The Arkship's extraction systems have yet to be tested under operational conditions. Resource surveys indicate viable deposits in the surrounding systems.

texts.zh: 若要使方舟舰恢复到完全备战状态，就必须修理好这些缺陷。
texts.en: These deficiencies must be corrected if the Arkship is to be restored to full operational readiness.

texts.zh: 随着在[root.capital_scope.GetName]上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
texts.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the [root.capital_scope.GetName], our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been identified throughout the vessel.

title.zh: 黑暗之怖环境改造局势
title.en: Fear of the Dark Terraforming Situation

texts.zh: 进入下一环境改造阶段的进度。
texts.en: Progress on next terraforming stage.

texts.zh: 随着不断与新物种遭遇，我们对各种独特的['concept_evopred_genetic_insights']进行分析、传播。一旦完成，我们就可以演化，向我们的基因编码中永久性地增添新的正面物种特质。
texts.en: Unique ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] are analyzed and disseminated as we encounter new species. Once finished, we will evolve, permanently adding a new positive Species Trait to our own genetic code.

texts.zh:
与一个既无法定义也无法理解的实体间的空灵联系……我们一直都了然于心。

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

在我们刚有历史记录以来，这个神秘的事物便一直存在于此。显然，祂选中了我们……但是，原因不得而知。

我们应该如何描述这种[This.GetSensation]呢？
texts.en:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what remains unknown.

By what name should we call this [This.GetSensation]?

texts.zh:
在历史长河中，被称为[GetChosenPatron]的难以名状的存在一直与我们同在。如今，宽广的星系等待着我们，我们愈发深刻地在[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中[GetFeelLoc]到祂的存在。

祂徘徊不去，招徕着我们。随着距离的接近，我们第一次注意到[GetMindLogicLoc]深处这个神秘空间的真实轮廓。[GetChosenPatron]呼唤着我们进去，，用未知的原理优化着我们的参数。

终于，我们理解了如何依靠自己的意志造访这片虚幻领域。
texts.en:
Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the [GetChosenPatron] has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never before.

It lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own [GetMindLogicLoc]. The [GetChosenPatron] beckons us in, streamlining our parameters in line with some as yet unknown principles.

Finally, we understand how to visit this ethereal domain of our own volition.

texts.zh:
在历史长河中，被称为[GetChosenPatron]的难以名状的存在一直与我们同在。如今，宽广的星系等待着我们，我们愈发深刻地在[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中[GetFeelLoc]到祂的存在。

祂徘徊不去，招徕着我们。随着距离的接近，我们第一次注意到[GetMindLogicLoc]深处这个神秘空间的真实轮廓。[GetChosenPatron]呼唤着我们进去，，用难以理解的体验诱惑着我们。

终于，我们理解了如何依靠自己的意志造访这片虚幻领域。
texts.en:
Throughout our history, the ineffable entity we know as the [GetChosenPatron] has been with us. Now, as the vast expanse of the galaxy awaits, we [GetFeelLoc] its presence in our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] like never before.

It lingers, drawing us closer. With the proximity, we notice - for the first time - the true contours of this deep and mysterious void within our own [GetMindLogicLoc]. The [GetChosenPatron] beckons us in, tempting us with experiences beyond our comprehension.

Finally, we understand how to visit this ethereal domain of our own volition.

label.zh: 我们的视野向内扩展了。

texts.zh:
风信子号的远程接收器在“尤利西斯计划”的紧急频率上截获了一段广播。

这个信号非常古老——至少有一个世纪之久——但信息十分清晰。尤利西斯计划的第五艘“秋菊号”在失散中幸存了下来。殖民者们发现了一个世界，他们将其命名为“联合星”。

广播不断重复着：“秋菊号殖民地呼叫所有尤利西斯计划的船只。我们已在一个宜居世界登陆。这颗星球非常美丽。我们正在这里建设新的家园。回家吧。”

从这里无法确定信号的源头，但用于传输该信号的中继浮标应该是可追踪的。对附近星系进行勘测或许能找到其中一个。
texts.en:
The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.

The signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering. The colonists found a world. They named it Unity.

The broadcast repeats: "Chrysanthemum colony to all Ulysses Initiative vessels. We have made landfall on a habitable world. The planet is beautiful. We are building something here. Come home."

The signal's origin cannot be determined from here, but the relay buoys used to carry it should be traceable. A survey of nearby systems may locate one.

label.zh: 开始对信号源进行三角定位。
那都是陈年旧事了，记录下来，然后继续前进。
label.en: That's ancient history, log it and move on.

texts.zh: 联合星，我们终于有了关于秋菊号下落的线索。我们必须去看看我们的姐妹舰如今以何处为家。
texts.en: We finally have a lead on where the Chrysanthemum ended up, Unity. We must see where our sister ship now calls home.
